random_search.method: random search: every batch is population genomes uniform in [0, 1] per gene; nothing is learnt from one batch to the next
random_search.genomes: numpy.random.default_rng(run seed), the GA's own stream: batch 0 is the GA's initial population (without --seed-reference)
random_search.training_seeds: batch g is scored on the terrain seeds of GA generation g of the same run seed (seeds.training_per_generation), with the same fitness
random_search.validated: the validation genomes best designs of all batches by training fitness (random_best = the best ever) and the reference design, on the run's validation seeds

fitness.rule: Deb (2000) feasibility rules: a legal design beats an illegal one; legal designs by larger distance; illegal designs by smaller total violation. Legality is the design's: the same on every terrain seed
fitness.formula: legal: fitness = mean over the generation's terrain seeds of max_distance_m (metres); illegal: fitness = -(infeasible_offset + total_violation), dimensionless, total_violation = sum(violation.magnitude)

success.criterion: partial delivery, section 6.3: the best design is legal (feasible) and finishes on at least 3 of 5 validation terrains (with another number of validation terrains, the same share rounded up). The best design of a GA run is the final population's best (final_best); of a random search, its best design by training fitness (random_best)
